Circular No:- 44/2025
All Chief Secretaries to Provincial Councils
All Secretaries to Provincial Ministries of Education
All Provincial Directors of Education
All Zonal Directors of Education
All Principals of National Schools
All Presidents of National Colleges of Education
Duty Hours of Non-academic Staff employed at National Schools, National Colleges of Education, Teacher Training Colleges and Teacher Development Centers
Issued in accordance with Public Administration Circulars 9/2006, 27/2013, 08/2014 and 29/2017.
Secondary-level officers serve 7 hours 45 minutes per day; junior staff 8 hours 45 minutes.

gold.issuedBy: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education
gold.targetAudience: Provincial Councils and Ministries of Education, Provincial/Zonal Directors, National School principals, NCE presidents, Teacher Training College principals, TDC managers
gold.title: MOE Circular 44/2025: Duty hours for non-academic staff in MOE institutions

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.content: Sets duty hours for non-academic staff in National Schools, National Colleges of Education, Teacher Training Colleges, and Teacher Development Centers under the Ministry.

sections.heading: Key requirements
sections.content: Secondary-level cadres (e.g. Development Officers, ICT, Librarians, Management Service Officers) work 7 hours 45 minutes daily. Junior/primary staff work 8 hours 45 minutes. Heads must prepare local duty rosters consistent with Public Administration Circulars, including driver and security arrangements.

sections.heading: Legal & circular references
sections.content: Circular No. 44/2025; Public Administration Circulars 9/2006, 27/2013, 08/2014, 29/2017; ED/12/01/01.

sections.heading: Responsible parties
sections.content: Institution heads (principals, presidents, managers) must implement duty-hour schedules and related deployment mechanisms.

actionItems: Align non-academic duty hours with the durations in Circular 44/2025.
Prepare institutional duty rosters for secondary and junior staff categories.
Apply Public Administration Circular 27/2013 rules for driver deployment where applicable.
Retain existing arrangements for residential posts not covered under paragraph 04 unless further directed.
